items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Vi told me to marry the one I married. I hadn't spoken to her in 6 months and I talked to her. I said, 'Would you marry me?'

ctx.x: life but eventually they did get a divorce and you know Vi's married to Buddy now. But HINTON: Vi - oh, she was married to Jimmy Jones at one time. JONES: Vi told me to marry the one I married. I hadn't spoken to her in 6 months and I talked to her. I said, "Would you marry me?" because I wanted to get with this band.
